south_africa.title: The Black Affairs Administration Act comes into force
south_africa.text: The Black Affairs Administration Act No 45 commences. This Act provided for black self-government in townships. It was repealed by section 69 of the Black Communities Development Act No 4 of 1984.

world.text: Texas Revolution: Texian forces attacked a Mexican pack train, capturing 40 saddlebags of grass.
A large internal explosion destroyed HMS Bulwark near Sheerness, killing 741 people on board.
A riot involving infantrymen, military police, and local law enforcement officers killed three people in Phoenix, Arizona.
A speaker claiming to represent the "Intergalactic Association" interrupted a broadcast of Southern Television in South East England.
The Mars Science Laboratory mission, carrying the Curiosity rover on board, was launched from Cape Canaveral.
